name: Chevalle's Slow-Braised Lamb Shank / Veal Osso Buco with Polenta (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Hours of slow braising turn the shank meat fork-tender over smooth creamy polenta or mashed potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim away any thick exterior fat pockets, ask for the braising gravy on the side, and skip any citrus gremolata garnish.
watchOuts: Rendered lamb fat if not trimmed
